title: Physical Ryo and Player Payments
body:
Ryo can be carried in your wallet or left as physical coin piles.

drop 500 ryo -- take 500 Ryo from your wallet and leave one pile.
drop all ryo -- drop your entire wallet as one pile.
look ryo -- examine a pile on the ground.
get ryo -- collect the first pile into your wallet.
get 500 ryo -- collect a pile worth exactly 500.
get 2.ryo -- collect the second pile in a room.
get all ryo -- collect every Ryo pile in the room.
give 500 ryo <player> -- pay another player in your room.
give all ryo <player> -- hand over your entire wallet.

All amounts must be positive whole numbers and cannot exceed the Ryo you possess. Physical piles persist across server restarts; picking up Ryo does not require an inventory item slot.
